primary_products.value: CAD software; product lifecycle management software; industrial IoT software; augmented reality software; industrial connectivity software

primary_services.value: software implementation; technical support; training; consulting

customer_segment.value: B2B: manufacturers, aerospace and automotive companies, medical device makers, engineering firms

end_markets.value: discrete manufacturing; aerospace and defense; automotive; medical devices; high-tech electronics

revenue_model.value: subscription: cloud and term license subscriptions for design and lifecycle software; licensing or royalties: perpetual software licenses; service fees: maintenance, support and professional services
revenue_model.category: subscription; licensing or royalties; service fees
